global_sign_anchor: equal-family mean of the prepared confidence-oriented coordinates
global_sign_rule: when a method's fused confidence score has an unresolved global sign, multiply it by the sign of its Pearson correlation with the anchor; require absolute correlation above 1e-6; never reorient individual features

methods.plain_description: Average every available transformed measurement, then negate the confidence average to obtain risk.
methods.access: one saved generation and its output-probability telemetry
methods.known_limit: large feature families receive more total weight

methods.plain_description: Average measurements inside each available provenance family and then average the family scores, so a large family gets no extra votes.
methods.origin: project reference floor using the frozen six-family provenance map
methods.access: one saved generation and its output-probability telemetry
methods.assumption: families, rather than individual columns, should have equal prior mass
methods.fallback: equal-feature mean if no family map is available
methods.known_limit: the six families are manually defined

methods.plain_description: Cluster measurements that appear dependent, fuse within each cluster, and fuse the cluster scores while preserving score magnitude.

symbols.F_g: measurement block assigned to cluster g

methods.origin: continuous project adaptation of the L-SML/SML dependent-ensemble line
methods.access: one saved generation and its output-probability telemetry
methods.assumption: dependent measurements can be represented by approximately independent clusters
methods.fallback: no silent substitution; a near-tied grouping is retained only with an explicit degeneracy diagnostic
methods.known_limit: the original guarantees are for binary classifier outputs, whereas this arm uses continuous measurements

methods.plain_description: Use the parameter-free DUFS smoothness objective to keep measurements, then fuse the selected measurements with Continuous L-SML.

symbols.mu_j: DUFS stochastic-gate mean for measurement j

methods.origin: Lindenbaum et al. DUFS (2021), connected to the project's continuous L-SML scorer
methods.access: one saved generation and its output-probability telemetry
methods.assumption: measurements that preserve stable local sample geometry are useful for fusion
methods.fallback: full-pool L-SML if fewer than three measurements survive
methods.known_limit: smoothness is not the same as relevance to correctness

methods.plain_description: Choose the DUFS penalty whose selected columns agree most across five random seeds, without labels, and fuse the resulting columns with Continuous L-SML.
methods.origin: project stability rule around the DUFS implementation embedded in the GroupFS study
methods.access: one saved generation and its output-probability telemetry
methods.assumption: a reproducible unlabeled selection is preferable to an unstable one
methods.fallback: full-pool L-SML if no admissible selection keeps at least three but fewer than all measurements
methods.known_limit: stability can preserve a nuisance just as reliably as correctness signal

methods.plain_description: Infer each measurement's relationship to an unobserved shared target from covariance, remove measurements estimated to be weak, refit, and combine the survivors.

symbols.rho_i: estimated covariance of measurement i with the hidden target

methods.origin: Dror et al., Unsupervised Ensemble Regression (2017), with the project's documented exclusion/refit path
methods.access: one saved generation and its output-probability telemetry
methods.assumption: measurement errors are pairwise uncorrelated after conditioning on one shared target
methods.fallback: registered simple-average or abstention behavior, recorded per cell
methods.known_limit: covariance determines a global direction only up to sign; the frozen feature contract supplies orientation and no sign(rho) arm is added

methods.plain_description: Use the same covariance estimate as U-PCR but retain the full measurement pool; this is the matched non-graph control for later extensions.
methods.origin: project full-pool control derived from the U-PCR line
methods.access: one saved generation and its output-probability telemetry
methods.assumption: the same shared-target covariance model as U-PCR
methods.fallback: fail closed when fewer than three usable measurements remain
methods.known_limit: retaining all measurements can preserve correlated nuisance

methods.plain_description: Learn label-free soft gates that define answer similarity, build a duplicate-safe nearest-neighbour graph with a fixed row-ID tie rule, and penalize IU-PCR scores that vary sharply between neighbours.

symbols.L: normalized Laplacian of the DUFS-gated sample graph

methods.origin: project integration of DUFS with Laplacian-regularized IU-PCR
methods.access: one saved generation and its output-probability telemetry
methods.assumption: answers that are neighbours in gated measurement space should receive similar correctness risk
methods.fallback: fail closed with an explicit FIT_FAILED status if graph construction or the projected solve is invalid; no silent IU-PCR substitution
methods.known_limit: a stable graph may reflect length or another nuisance rather than correctness

methods.plain_description: Decompose measurement covariance into a low-rank shared part and sparse correlated errors before estimating the hidden target relationship.
methods.origin: Tenzer et al., Crowdsourcing Regression: A Spectral Approach (AISTATS 2022)
methods.access: one saved generation and its output-probability telemetry
methods.assumption: violations of the shared-target model are sparse in the covariance matrix
methods.fallback: fail closed with an explicit FIT_FAILED status if sparse decomposition or the PCR solve is invalid; no silent IU-PCR substitution
methods.known_limit: dense or structured dependence is not represented by a sparse error matrix

methods.plain_description: Treat each measurement as one view, balance near-duplicate families, and build duplicate-safe graphs that give more weight to views whose local answer neighbourhoods agree with other views before regularizing IU-PCR.
methods.origin: new aligned provenance-balanced atomic conditional-agreement adaptation of SpecRaGE; it is not the historical LOCO-micro CA arm
methods.access: one saved generation and its output-probability telemetry
methods.assumption: view agreement identifies a useful local geometry
methods.fallback: fail closed with an explicit FIT_FAILED status if graph fitting or the LIU solve is invalid; no silent IU-PCR substitution
methods.known_limit: agreement can reward duplicated nuisance; uniform, prior, global and permuted controls are required

methods.plain_description: Fit a nonlinear energy model directly to the continuous measurement vector and convert its latent posterior into answer risk.

symbols.ell_theta_aligned: learned additive family logit after one label-free global flip toward the equal-family risk anchor

methods.origin: project continuous additive, graph-free adaptation inspired by Maymon et al. DEEM (AISTATS 2026); not a direct reproduction of the published hard multinomial/iRBM model
methods.access: one saved generation and its output-probability telemetry
methods.assumption: a nonlinear energy model can expose a shared latent target despite measurement dependence
methods.fallback: explicit fit-failure status; no silent replacement by IU-PCR in headline scoring
methods.known_limit: our continuous B3 adapter changes the published DEEM observation model

methods.plain_description: Within one target cell, remove the shared IU-PCR score from each of six family contributions, find a fixed neutral residual direction, and add a small standardized correction to IU-PCR.

symbols.v_star: residual-covariance eigenvector whose eigenvalue is closest to one

methods.origin: new within-cell, donor-free ablation of the project's Family Neutral Residual Mode
methods.access: one saved generation and its output-probability telemetry
methods.assumption: a unit-variance residual mode represents a stable disagreement not already carried by IU-PCR
methods.fallback: AUROC/rank-equivalent standardized IU-PCR for fewer than three non-degenerate families, an ambiguous orientation tie, or zero correction variance
methods.known_limit: new unrun ablation; uses a manual six-family prior and the nearest-to-one rule is a heuristic

methods.plain_description: Within one cell, build a nearest-neighbour graph in residual family space and move IU-PCR in the fixed residual direction that most reduces graph roughness.

symbols.L: normalized Laplacian of the residual-space graph

methods.origin: new within-cell, donor-free cross-gradient ablation of the project's Pooled Graph-Roughness Direction
methods.access: one saved generation and its output-probability telemetry
methods.assumption: the residual-family graph contains target-relevant direction beyond IU-PCR
methods.fallback: AUROC/rank-equivalent standardized IU-PCR for fewer than three usable residual families or a degenerate graph, cross-gradient, or correction
methods.known_limit: new unrun ablation; uses the manual six-family prior and lower graph roughness does not by itself identify correctness
